title: THE RECURRENCE · DAY SEVEN
summary: Issue 8's final day closes with the E17/E18 feature-lead question exactly as unresolved as it opened the week — the comb tickler that was meant to settle it next fires 09-17, four days after this issue ends. The plan-wide burn rate trip held worse, not better (22.1/day observed vs 9.1/day affordable, weekly climbing 63%→65% intraday); OpenRouter stayed overdrawn a fourth straight day at -$0.17. GitHub Actions logged 37 runs by press time, roughly six times the prior day's volume. X-feed Dispatch No. 26 shipped text and audio (Qwen/DeepSeek on consumer hardware, the VulcanBench safety-eval launch, Robin Hanson on regulation vs. voluntary coordination).

The partial-day Cloudflare read is compared to yesterday's full-day figure explicitly as an unequal-window comparison, per the house rule against silent full/partial mismatches. The issue's close on an unresolved feature question is reported as the week's own answer, not as this record's failure to chase one down.
